title: Open-problem source screening ledger
policy: Conference open-problem collections are screened as discovery sources. An item enters the core Bandit/RL Frontier only if its mathematical contract is itself a bandit or reinforcement-learning question. Adjacent online learning, optimization, statistics, and games are routed to their own books/libraries rather than mixed into core BanditRLwiki.
